question.en: (Application - Wet Edge) What is the primary reason for "maintaining a wet edge" when spraying a large panel like a hood or roof?
question.ar: (التطبيق - الحافة الرطبة) ما هو السبب الرئيسي لـ "الحفاظ على حافة رطبة" عند رش لوحة كبيرة مثل غطاء المحرك أو السقف؟

choices.en: To ensure the paint dries as fast as possible.
choices.ar: لضمان جفاف الطلاء بأسرع ما يمكن.

choices.en: To prevent overspray from landing on a previously sprayed, semi-dry area, which causes a rough, uneven texture.
choices.ar: لمنع الرذاذ الزائد من الهبوط على منطقة تم رشها مسبقًا وشبه جافة، مما يسبب نسيجًا خشنًا وغير متساوٍ.

choices.en: To allow the painter to spray the panel in multiple, separate sections.
choices.ar: للسماح لفني الرش برش اللوحة في أقسام متعددة ومنفصلة.

choices.en: To make the metallic flakes stand up on end for a brighter finish.
choices.ar: لجعل رقائق المعدن تقف على نهايتها للحصول على لمسة نهائية أكثر إشراقًا.

en.plain: Why B is correct: Maintaining a wet edge is the technique of applying paint in a sequence so that each new pass of the gun overlaps with an area from the previous pass that is still wet. This allows the paint to flow together seamlessly into a single, uniform film. If you let an edge dry and then spray over it, you create a "dry line" or uneven texture because the new wet paint lands on a dry surface instead of flowing together with it. This is especially critical for clear coat and single-stage paint. Why A is incorrect: This technique is about achieving a smooth, uniform finish , not about drying speed. Why C is incorrect: The entire point of maintaining a wet edge is to paint the panel as one continuous section, not in separate sections which would create dry lines. Why D is incorrect: This technique ensures proper flow-out, which typically helps metallic flakes lie flatter and more uniformly, not stand on end.

• Why B is correct: Maintaining a wet edge is the technique of applying paint in a sequence so that each new pass of the gun overlaps with an area from the previous pass that is still wet. This allows the paint to flow together seamlessly into a single, uniform film. If you let an edge dry and then spray over it, you create a "dry line" or uneven texture because the new wet paint lands on a dry surface instead of flowing together with it. This is especially critical for clear coat and single-stage paint.
  • Why A is incorrect: This technique is about achieving a smooth, uniform finish, not about drying speed.
  • Why C is incorrect: The entire point of maintaining a wet edge is to paint the panel as one continuous section, not in separate sections which would create dry lines.
  • Why D is incorrect: This technique ensures proper flow-out, which typically helps metallic flakes lie flatter and more uniformly, not stand on end.

ar.plain: لماذا ب صحيح: الحفاظ على حافة رطبة هو تقنية تطبيق الطلاء في تسلسل بحيث تتداخل كل تمريرة جديدة للمسدس مع منطقة من التمريرة السابقة لا تزال رطبة. هذا يسمح للطلاء بالتدفق معًا بسلاسة في فيلم واحد موحد. إذا تركت حافة تجف ثم رشيت فوقها، فإنك تنشئ "خطًا جافًا" أو نسيجًا غير متساوٍ لأن الطلاء الرطب الجديد يهبط على سطح جاف بدلاً من التدفق معه. هذا أمر بالغ الأهمية بشكل خاص لطبقة الورنيش الشفاف والطلاء أحادي المرحلة. لماذا أ غير صحيح: تتعلق هذه التقنية بتحقيق لمسة نهائية ناعمة وموحدة، وليس سرعة الجفاف. لماذا ج غير صحيح: النقطة الأساسية في الحفاظ على حافة رطبة هي طلاء اللوحة كقسم واحد مستمر، وليس في أقسام منفصلة مما قد ينشئ خطوطًا جافة. لماذا د غير صحيح: تضمن هذه التقنية التدفق المناسب، مما يساعد عادةً رقائق المعدن على الاستقرار بشكل مسطح وأكثر توحيدًا، وليس الوقوف على نهايتها.

question.en: (Bleeding) A technician applies a light-coloured topcoat over an old, poorly-prepped red finish, and a pinkish discolouration seeps through the new paint. What is this defect called?
question.ar: (النزيف) فني يطبق طبقة علوية فاتحة اللون فوق طلاء أحمر قديم غير مُجهز جيدًا، ويظهر تلون وردي يتسرب عبر الطلاء الجديد. ماذا يسمى هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Blushing
Mottling
Bleeding
Chemical Spotting

en.plain: Why C is correct: Bleeding is the fault where soluble pigments or contaminants (like tar) from an underlying layer dissolve into the new topcoat's solvents and seep up, causing discolouration. This is common with red, maroon, or yellow pigments. Why A is incorrect: Blushing is a milky or hazy appearance in the clearcoat, caused by moisture (humidity) being trapped during the drying process, not by pigment. Why B is incorrect: Mottling relates to the uneven, streaky, or blotchy appearance of metallic or pearl flakes, not a colour discolouration from beneath. Why D is incorrect: Chemical Spotting (or etching) is damage to the surface of the topcoat caused by external substances like acid rain or bird droppings, not a pigment issue from below.

richText.content:
• Why C is correct: Bleeding is the fault where soluble pigments or contaminants (like tar) from an underlying layer dissolve into the new topcoat's solvents and seep up, causing discolouration. This is common with red, maroon, or yellow pigments.
  • Why A is incorrect: Blushing is a milky or hazy appearance in the clearcoat, caused by moisture (humidity) being trapped during the drying process, not by pigment.
  • Why B is incorrect: Mottling relates to the uneven, streaky, or blotchy appearance of metallic or pearl flakes, not a colour discolouration from beneath.
  • Why D is incorrect: Chemical Spotting (or etching) is damage to the surface of the topcoat caused by external substances like acid rain or bird droppings, not a pigment issue from below.

ar.plain: لماذا ج صحيح: النزيف هو عيب حيث تذوب الأصباغ القابلة للذوبان أو الملوثات (مثل القطران) من طبقة سفلية في مذيبات الطبقة العلوية الجديدة وتتسرب لأعلى، مسببة تغير اللون. هذا شائع مع الأصباغ الحمراء، أو العنابية، أو الصفراء. لماذا أ غير صحيح: الابيضاض هو مظهر حليبي أو ضبابي في طبقة الورنيش الشفاف، ناتج عن احتباس الرطوبة (الرطوبة) أثناء عملية الجفاف، وليس بسبب الصبغة. لماذا ب غير صحيح: التبقع يتعلق بالمظهر غير المتساوي، أو المخطط، أو المبقع لرقائق المعدن أو اللؤلؤ، وليس تغير لون من الأسفل. لماذا د غير صحيح: التبقيع الكيميائي (أو الحفر) هو ضرر لسطح الطبقة العلوية ناتج عن مواد خارجية مثل المطر الحمضي أو فضلات الطيور، وليس مشكلة صبغة من الأسفل.

question.en: (Blushing) A technician is spraying clearcoat on a very hot and humid day. The resulting finish has a milky, hazy, or dull appearance. What is this defect?
question.ar: (الابيضاض) فني يرش طبقة ورنيش شفاف في يوم حار ورطب جدًا. الطلاء النهائي له مظهر حليبي أو ضبابي أو باهت. ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Blushing
Bleeding
Dry Spray
Chalking

en.plain: Why A is correct: Blushing (or milkiness) is caused by moisture (humidity) in the air condensing onto or in the wet paint film as it dries. The rapid evaporation of solvents cools the surface, causing this condensation, which gets trapped and results in a milky look. Why B is incorrect: Bleeding is a pigment discolouration from an underlying layer. Why C is incorrect: Dry Spray would result in a rough, sandy texture because the paint droplets dried before flowing out, but not typically a milky appearance. Why D is incorrect: Chalking is the slow oxidation and powdering of a paint surface over a long period of UV exposure, not an immediate application fault.

richText.content:
• Why A is correct: Blushing (or milkiness) is caused by moisture (humidity) in the air condensing onto or in the wet paint film as it dries. The rapid evaporation of solvents cools the surface, causing this condensation, which gets trapped and results in a milky look.
  • Why B is incorrect: Bleeding is a pigment discolouration from an underlying layer.
  • Why C is incorrect: Dry Spray would result in a rough, sandy texture because the paint droplets dried before flowing out, but not typically a milky appearance.
  • Why D is incorrect: Chalking is the slow oxidation and powdering of a paint surface over a long period of UV exposure, not an immediate application fault.

ar.plain: لماذا أ صحيح: الابيضاض (أو المظهر الحليبي) ناتج عن تكثف الرطوبة (الرطوبة) في الهواء على أو في طبقة الطلاء الرطبة أثناء جفافها. يؤدي التبخر السريع للمذيبات إلى تبريد السطح، مما يتسبب في هذا التكثيف، الذي يُحتبس وينتج عنه مظهر حليبي. لماذا ب غير صحيح: النزيف هو تغير لون الصبغة من طبقة سفلية. لماذا ج غير صحيح: الرش الجاف ينتج عنه ملمس خشن ورملي لأن قطرات الطلاء جفت قبل أن تتدفق، ولكن ليس عادة مظهرًا حليبيًا. لماذا د غير صحيح: التطبشر هو الأكسدة البطيئة وتحول سطح الطلاء إلى مسحوق على مدى فترة طويلة من التعرض للأشعة فوق البنفسجية، وليس عيب تطبيق فوري.

question.en: (Chalking) An older, single-stage red vehicle is brought in for detailing. The paint surface is dull and has a light-coloured, powdery coating. What is this condition?
question.ar: (التطبشر) تم إحضار مركبة حمراء قديمة ذات طلاء أحادي المرحلة للتلميع. سطح الطلاء باهت وعليه طبقة مسحوقية فاتحة اللون. ما هي هذه الحالة؟

choices.en: Chemical Spotting
Poor Gloss / Die-Back
choices.ar: لمعان ضعيف / تراجع اللمعان (Poor Gloss / Die-Back)

choices.en: Dry Spray
Chalking

en.plain: Why D is correct: Chalking (also called fading or oxidation) is the natural weathering and breakdown of the paint's binder at the surface due to long-term UV exposure. This releases the pigment particles, creating a dull, powdery film. It is most common on older single-stage finishes. Why A is incorrect: Chemical Spotting would appear as irregular-shaped pits or etches, not a uniform powdery dullness. Why B is incorrect: Poor Gloss / Die-Back is a loss of shine that happens shortly after a new paint job as solvents continue to escape, causing the film to sink. Chalking is a long-term weathering defect. Why C is incorrect: Dry Spray is a rough application texture, not a defect that develops over time.

ar.plain: لماذا د صحيح: التطبشر (يسمى أيضًا البهتان أو الأكسدة) هو التجوية الطبيعية وتحلل المادة الرابطة للطلاء على السطح بسبب التعرض الطويل الأمد للأشعة فوق البنفسجية. يؤدي هذا إلى إطلاق جزيئات الصبغة، مما يخلق طبقة باهتة ومسحوقية. وهو الأكثر شيوعًا في التشطيبات أحادية المرحلة القديمة. لماذا أ غير صحيح: التبقيع الكيميائي يظهر على شكل حفر أو نقوش غير منتظمة الشكل، وليس بهتانًا مسحوقيًا موحدًا. لماذا ب غير صحيح: اللمعان الضعيف / تراجع اللمعان هو فقدان اللمعان الذي يحدث بعد وقت قصير من طلاء جديد حيث تستمر المذيبات في الهروب، مما يتسبب في هبوط الطبقة. التطبشر هو عيب تجوية طويل الأمد. لماذا ج غير صحيح: الرش الجاف هو نسيج تطبيق خشن، وليس عيبًا يتطور بمرور الوقت.

question.en: (Contour Mapping) After a repair is refinished, the entire outline of the underlying body filler and its feather-edged area becomes visible through the topcoat. What is this defect?
question.ar: (تخطيط المحيط) بعد إعادة طلاء إصلاح، يصبح المخطط الكامل لمعجون الهيكل الأساسي ومنطقته المتدرجة الحواف مرئيًا من خلال الطبقة العلوية. ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Lifting
Sanding Marks
Contour Mapping
Peeling

en.plain: Why C is correct: Contour Mapping (or 'Bull's-Eye') is the visible outline of a repair's feather-edge. It's often caused by solvents from the new paint swelling the sensitive "broken" edge of the old paint, or by the different absorption rates of the filler, primer, and old paint. Why A is incorrect: Lifting is a more severe, immediate reaction where the old paint shrivels and puckers, typically at the feather-edge, but contour mapping is a more subtle sinking or swelling that forms an outline. Why B is incorrect: Sanding Marks (or Sand Scratch Swelling) are the individual scratches from coarse sandpaper that swell and become visible, whereas contour mapping is the outline of the entire repair area . Why D is incorrect: Peeling is a loss of adhesion, which is a different failure mechanism.

ar.plain: لماذا ج صحيح: تخطيط المحيط (أو "عين الثور") هو المخطط المرئي للحافة المتدرجة للإصلاح. غالبًا ما يكون سببه مذيبات من الطلاء الجديد تتسبب في انتفاخ الحافة "المكسورة" الحساسة للطلاء القديم، أو بسبب معدلات الامتصاص المختلفة للمعجون والبرايمر والطلاء القديم. لماذا أ غير صحيح: الرفع هو رد فعل فوري أكثر شدة حيث يتجعد الطلاء القديم ويتقبض، عادة عند الحافة المتدرجة، لكن تخطيط المحيط هو هبوط أو انتفاخ أكثر دقة يشكل مخططًا. لماذا ب غير صحيح: علامات الصنفرة (أو تورم خدش الصنفرة) هي الخدوش الفردية من ورق الصنفرة الخشن التي تنتفخ وتصبح مرئية، بينما تخطيط المحيط هو مخطط منطقة الإصلاح بأكملها . لماذا د غير صحيح: التقشير هو فقدان الالتصاق، وهو آلية فشل مختلفة.

question.en: (Cracking) A paint film exhibits a widespread pattern of fine, hairline "crow's feet" or "checking" that penetrates the surface. What is this defect?
question.ar: (التشقق) يُظهر فيلم الطلاء نمطًا واسع الانتشار من "أقدام الغراب" الدقيقة أو "التفحص" الذي يخترق السطح. ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Wrinkling
Cracking
Lifting
Peeling

en.plain: Why B is correct: Cracking (also called checking or crazing) describes a breakdown of the paint film that starts as fine lines and can develop into deeper splits. It's often caused by excessive film thickness, insufficient hardener in a 2K product, or applying a new finish over an old, incompatible one. Why A is incorrect: Wrinkling is a shriveled, prune-like texture that happens when a new coat is applied over a partially dry or incompatible layer (like enamel), causing the surface to shrink unevenly. Why C is incorrect: Lifting is an immediate, localized swelling and shriveling at the edge of a repair. Why D is incorrect: Peeling is a loss of adhesion, where the paint flakes or separates from the substrate.

question.en: (Curing Failure) A technician mixes a 2K (two-component) primer-surfacer but forgets to add the hardener (catalyst). What will be the result?
question.ar: (فشل المعالجة) يخلط فني برايمر-سيرفيسر 2K (ثنائي المكونات) ولكنه ينسى إضافة المصلب (المحفز). ماذا ستكون النتيجة؟

choices.en: Curing/Drying Failure
Solvent Popping
Lifting
Cracking

en.plain: Why A is correct: Curing/Drying Failure occurs when a thermoset (2K) product fails to cross-link and harden. This is most commonly caused by adding no hardener, the wrong hardener, or an incorrect mixing ratio. The paint will remain soft and sticky indefinitely. Why B is incorrect: Solvent Popping is caused by trapped solvents boiling through a paint film that has skinned over too quickly. Why C is incorrect: Lifting is a reaction with an underlying sensitive substrate. Why D is incorrect: Cracking is a failure of a cured film, often due to excessive thickness. This film will never cure at all.

  • Why B is incorrect: Solvent Popping is caused by trapped solvents boiling through a paint film that has skinned over too quickly.
  • Why C is incorrect: Lifting is a reaction with an underlying sensitive substrate.
  • Why D is incorrect: Cracking is a failure of a cured film, often due to excessive thickness. This film will never cure at all.

question.en: (Dirt Nibs) Small, raised particles of dust or debris are embedded in the final, cured clearcoat. What is this defect?
question.ar: (نتوءات الأوساخ) جزيئات صغيرة ومرتفعة من الغبار أو الحطام مغروسة في طبقة الورنيش الشفاف النهائية والمعالجة. ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Fish Eyes
Pinholes
Dirt Nibs
Solvent Popping

en.plain: Why C is correct: Dirt Nibs (or dust contamination) are simply airborne particles (dust, lint, debris) that land on the wet paint film during application or flashing. Why A is incorrect: Fish Eyes are small, circular craters caused by contamination (like silicone or oil) on the substrate , which repels the wet paint. Why B is incorrect: Pinholes are tiny holes in body filler or primer , typically from trapped air or over-catalyzation. Why D is incorrect: Solvent Popping results in popped blisters or craters caused by trapped solvents escaping from within the paint, not external debris landing on it.

  • Why B is incorrect: Pinholes are tiny holes in body filler or primer, typically from trapped air or over-catalyzation.
  • Why D is incorrect: Solvent Popping results in popped blisters or craters caused by trapped solvents escaping from within the paint, not external debris landing on it.

question.en: (Dry Spray) A technician holds the spray gun too far from the panel, causing the paint to have a rough, sandy texture with a dull shine. What is this defect?
question.ar: (الرش الجاف) يمسك فني مسدس الرش بعيدًا جدًا عن اللوحة، مما يتسبب في أن يكون للطلاء ملمس خشن ورملي مع لمعان باهت. ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Orange Peel
Dry Spray
Blushing
Chalking

en.plain: Why B is correct: Dry Spray occurs when paint droplets partially dry in the air before hitting the panel. They fail to flow together, resulting in a rough, dry, sandy texture. This is caused by excessive gun distance, reducer/solvent that is too fast, or high shop temperatures. Why A is incorrect: Orange Peel is a dimpled texture (like an orange) where the paint has flowed, but not enough to level out completely. Dry spray has not flowed at all. question.en: (Fish Eyes) During clearcoat application, the paint pulls away from small, circular areas on the panel, forming craters that look like a "fish eye" and often expose the basecoat. What is the most likely cause?
question.ar: (عيون السمكة) أثناء تطبيق طبقة الورنيش الشفاف، ينسحب الطلاء بعيدًا عن مناطق دائرية صغيرة على اللوحة، مكونًا فوهات تشبه "عين السمكة" وغالبًا ما تكشف عن طبقة الأساس. ما هو السبب الأكثر احتمالاً؟

choices.en: Trapped solvents
Silicone or oil contamination
High humidity
Trapped air in the paint

en.plain: Why B is correct: Fish Eyes are a classic sign of surface contamination. Low surface tension contaminants (like silicone, wax, or oil from shop air, dirty rags, or skin) on the panel repel the wet paint, causing it to draw back and form a crater. Why A is incorrect: Trapped solvents would cause solvent popping (blisters), not craters that repel paint. Why C is incorrect: High humidity would cause blushing (milkiness). Why D is incorrect: Trapped air would cause pinholes in primer or filler, not fish eyes in topcoat.

question.en: (Kick Out) A technician mixes two incompatible paint products. As they are stirred, solid, grit-like particles form in the mixture. What is this defect called?
question.ar: (الطرد) يخلط فني منتجي طلاء غير متوافقين. أثناء تحريكهما، تتكون جزيئات صلبة شبيهة بالحصى في الخليط. ماذا يسمى هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Thickening
Curing Failure
Kick Out
Pinholing

en.plain: Why C is correct: Kick Out (or seediness/grittiness) is when solid particles precipitate out of a liquid paint solution. This is a chemical reaction, often caused by mixing incompatible products (e.g., wrong hardener), adding a catalyst too quickly ("shocking" the product), or using material that has exceeded its shelf life. Why A is incorrect: Thickening is an increase in viscosity (bodying up), often as a product approaches the end of its pot life, but it doesn't typically form solid particles. Why B is incorrect: Curing Failure is when the paint fails to harden after application. Why D is incorrect: Pinholing occurs in body filler, not in the paint mixing cup.

question.en: (Lifting) A technician applies primer-surfacer over a poorly-sanded, solvent-sensitive old finish. The old paint at the feather-edge immediately shrivels, swells, and puckers. What is this defect?
question.ar: (الرفع) يطبق فني برايمر-سيرفيسر فوق طلاء قديم حساس للمذيبات ومصنفر بشكل سيء. يتجعد الطلاء القديم عند الحافة المتدرجة وينتفخ ويتقبض على الفور. ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Cracking
Wrinkling
Lifting
Contour Mapping

en.plain: Why C is correct: Lifting (or shriveling/raising) is a severe, immediate reaction where solvents from the new paint attack a sensitive underlying layer (like old lacquer or a poorly-cured enamel), causing it to swell and "lift" off the substrate. Why B is incorrect: Wrinkling is a similar but often less severe surface-level distortion that can happen when applying a coat over a partially dry coat of the same material (e.g., enamel). Lifting is a substrate-to-new-coat reaction. Why A is incorrect: Cracking is the fracturing of a cured paint film. Why D is incorrect: Contour Mapping is the outline of the repair showing, which is a much less aggressive defect than the shriveling of lifting.

question.en: (Mottling) A technician applies a silver metallic basecoat, and the finish has an uneven, streaky, or "tiger stripe" appearance. What is this defect?
question.ar: (التبقع) يطبق فني طبقة أساس فضية معدنية، والطلاء النهائي له مظهر غير متساوٍ أو مخطط أو "يشبه خطوط النمر". ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Orange Peel
Dry Spray
Mottling
Bleeding

en.plain: Why C is correct: Mottling (also streaking or floating) is the uneven distribution of metallic or pearl flakes in the paint film. This is purely an application error, often caused by incorrect gun technique (arcing), improper air pressure, or using a solvent that is too slow, which allows the flakes to "float" together unevenly as it dries. Why A is incorrect: Orange Peel is a uniform dimpled texture, not a streaky pattern. Why B is incorrect: Dry Spray is a uniform sandy texture, not a streaky pattern. Why D is incorrect: Bleeding is a pigment discolouration from an underlying layer.

Solvent Popping

question.en: (Overspray) A technician paints a fender but fails to properly mask the adjacent door. The door now has a hazy, rough film of paint mist on it. What is this defect?
question.ar: (الرش الزائد) يقوم فني بطلاء رفرف ولكنه يفشل في إخفاء الباب المجاور بشكل صحيح. الباب الآن عليه طبقة ضبابية وخشنة من رذاذ الطلاء. ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Chalking
Dry Spray
Fading
Overspray

en.plain: Why D is correct: Overspray is any paint mist that misses the intended target panel and lands on an adjacent surface. It feels rough because it is essentially dry spray. Why B is incorrect: Dry Spray is the same physical phenomenon, but the term is typically used to describe the defect on the intended panel. When it's on an unintended panel, it's called overspray. Why A & C are incorrect: Chalking and Fading are long-term weathering defects.

• Why D is correct: Overspray is any paint mist that misses the intended target panel and lands on an adjacent surface. It feels rough because it is essentially dry spray.
  • Why B is incorrect: Dry Spray is the same physical phenomenon, but the term is typically used to describe the defect on the intended panel. When it's on an unintended panel, it's called overspray.
  • Why A & C are incorrect: Chalking and Fading are long-term weathering defects.

ar.plain: لماذا د صحيح: الرش الزائد هو أي رذاذ طلاء يخطئ اللوحة المستهدفة المقصودة ويهبط على سطح مجاور. يكون ملمسه خشنًا لأنه في الأساس رش جاف. لماذا ب غير صحيح: الرش الجاف هو نفس الظاهرة الفيزيائية، ولكن المصطلح يستخدم عادة لوصف العيب على اللوحة المقصودة . عندما يكون على لوحة غير مقصودة ، يطلق عليه رش زائد. لماذا أ و ج غير صحيحين: التطبشر و البهتان هما عيوب تجوية طويلة الأمد.

question.en: (Peeling/Delamination) A vehicle's clearcoat is flaking and separating from the basecoat in large sheets, indicating a complete loss of adhesion. What is this defect?
question.ar: (التقشير/التصفح) طبقة الورنيش الشفاف للمركبة تتقشر وتنفصل عن طبقة الأساس في صفائح كبيرة، مما يشير إلى فقدان كامل للالتصاق. ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Peeling / Delamination
Cracking
Lifting
Blistering

en.plain: Why A is correct: Peeling (or Delamination ) is the loss of adhesion between paint layers (e.g., clear from base) or from the substrate (e.g., paint from primer). It is often caused by improper surface preparation (no sanding), contamination, or recoating outside the specified "recoat window." Why B is incorrect: Cracking is when the film fractures but remains attached. Why C is incorrect: Lifting is an immediate swelling/shriveling reaction during application. Why D is incorrect: Blistering is the formation of bubbles, usually from trapped moisture or solvent.

richText.content:
• Why A is correct: Peeling (or Delamination) is the loss of adhesion between paint layers (e.g., clear from base) or from the substrate (e.g., paint from primer). It is often caused by improper surface preparation (no sanding), contamination, or recoating outside the specified "recoat window."
  • Why B is incorrect: Cracking is when the film fractures but remains attached.
  • Why C is incorrect: Lifting is an immediate swelling/shriveling reaction during application.
  • Why D is incorrect: Blistering is the formation of bubbles, usually from trapped moisture or solvent.

ar.plain: لماذا أ صحيح: التقشير (أو التصفح ) هو فقدان الالتصاق بين طبقات الطلاء (مثل الورنيش الشفاف من طبقة الأساس) أو من الركيزة (مثل الطلاء من البرايمر). غالبًا ما يكون سببه تحضير السطح بشكل غير صحيح (بدون صنفرة)، أو التلوث، أو إعادة الطلاء خارج "نافذة إعادة الطلاء" المحددة. لماذا ب غير صحيح: التشقق هو عندما تتكسر الطبقة ولكنها تظل متصلة. لماذا ج غير صحيح: الرفع هو رد فعل انتفاخ/تقبض فوري أثناء التطبيق. لماذا د غير صحيح: التقرح هو تكوين فقاعات، عادةً بسبب الرطوبة أو المذيبات المحتبسة.

question.en: (Pinholes) After sanding body filler, a technician notices many tiny, deep holes in the filler's surface. What are these defects?
question.ar: (الثقوب الدبوسية) بعد صنفرة معجون الهيكل، يلاحظ فني العديد من الثقوب الصغيرة والعميقة في سطح المعجون. ما هي هذه العيوب؟

choices.en: Fish Eyes
Pinholes
Solvent Popping
Dirt Nibs

en.plain: Why B is correct: Pinholes are small voids in body filler or thick primer. They are caused by trapping air during mixing (e.g., "whipping" the filler) or during application (e.g., "blobbing" it on instead of spreading it thin). Over-catalyzation can also cause gases that result in pinholes. Why A, C, and D are incorrect: Fish Eyes , Solvent Popping , and Dirt Nibs are all paint defects, not body filler defects.

richText.content:
• Why B is correct: Pinholes are small voids in body filler or thick primer. They are caused by trapping air during mixing (e.g., "whipping" the filler) or during application (e.g., "blobbing" it on instead of spreading it thin). Over-catalyzation can also cause gases that result in pinholes.
  • Why A, C, and D are incorrect: Fish Eyes, Solvent Popping, and Dirt Nibs are all paint defects, not body filler defects.

ar.plain: لماذا ب صحيح: الثقوب الدبوسية هي فراغات صغيرة في معجون الهيكل أو البرايمر السميك. تحدث بسبب احتباس الهواء أثناء الخلط (مثل "خفق" المعجون) أو أثناء التطبيق (مثل "تكديسه" بدلاً من فرده رقيقًا). يمكن أن يتسبب التحفيز المفرط أيضًا في غازات تؤدي إلى ثقوب دبوسية. لماذا أ، ج، ود غير صحيحة: عيون السمكة ، فرقعة المذيب ، و نتوءات الأوساخ كلها عيوب طلاء ، وليست عيوب معجون الهيكل.

question.en: (Poor Gloss / Die-Back) A technician applies clearcoat, and it looks glossy, but after 24 hours, the finish appears dull and has lost its shine. What is this defect called?
question.ar: (لمعان ضعيف / تراجع اللمعان) يطبق فني طبقة ورنيش شفاف، وتبدو لامعة، ولكن بعد 24 ساعة، يبدو الطلاء باهتًا وفقد لمعانه. ماذا يسمى هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Blushing
Poor Gloss / Die-Back
choices.ar: لمعان ضعيف / تراجع اللمعان (Poor Gloss / Die-Back)

choices.en: Chalking
Orange Peel

en.plain: Why B is correct: Poor Gloss (or Die-Back ) is a loss of gloss that occurs after the paint has dried. It's often caused by trapped solvents from a previous layer (e.g., basecoat not flashed long enough) slowly seeping into the new clearcoat and causing it to sink and dull. Polishing too soon can also cause this. Why A is incorrect: Blushing is a milky defect that is visible immediately during the drying process. Why C is incorrect: Chalking is a weathering defect that takes months or years to appear. Why D is incorrect: Orange Peel is a texture defect, not a loss of gloss.

Polishing too soon can also cause this.

  • Why C is incorrect: Chalking is a weathering defect that takes months or years to appear.
  • Why D is incorrect: Orange Peel is a texture defect, not a loss of gloss.

question.en: (Runs or Sags) A technician applies clearcoat too heavily on a vertical panel, and the paint begins to flow downwards in a curtain-like shape. What is this defect?
question.ar: (السيلان أو الترهل) يطبق فني طبقة ورنيش شفاف بكثافة كبيرة على لوحة رأسية، ويبدأ الطلاء في التدفق لأسفل في شكل يشبه الستارة. ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Wrinkling
Runs or Sags
Lifting
Solvent Popping

en.plain: Why B is correct: Runs or Sags (also called 'hangers' or 'curtains') are caused by applying too much paint, which overcomes its own surface tension and flows downwards due to gravity. This is caused by moving the gun too slowly, holding it too close, or using a solvent that is too slow. Why A & C are incorrect: Wrinkling and Lifting are chemical reaction defects, not flow defects. Why D is incorrect: Solvent Popping is caused by trapped solvent, not excessive material flow.

• Why B is correct: Runs or Sags (also called 'hangers' or 'curtains') are caused by applying too much paint, which overcomes its own surface tension and flows downwards due to gravity. This is caused by moving the gun too slowly, holding it too close, or using a solvent that is too slow.
  • Why A & C are incorrect: Wrinkling and Lifting are chemical reaction defects, not flow defects.
  • Why D is incorrect: Solvent Popping is caused by trapped solvent, not excessive material flow.

ar.plain: لماذا ب صحيح: السيلان أو الترهل (يسمى أيضًا "الشماعات" أو "الستائر") ناتج عن تطبيق كمية كبيرة جدًا من الطلاء، والتي تتغلب على التوتر السطحي الخاص بها وتتدفق لأسفل بسبب الجاذبية. يحدث هذا بسبب تحريك المسدس ببطء شديد، أو إمساكه قريبًا جدًا، أو استخدام مذيب بطيء جدًا. لماذا أ و ج غير صحيحين: التجعد و الرفع هما عيوب تفاعل كيميائي، وليست عيوب تدفق. لماذا د غير صحيح: فرقعة المذيب ناتجة عن مذيب محتبس، وليس تدفق مفرط للمواد.

  • لماذا د غير صحيح: فرقعة المذيب ناتجة عن مذيب محتبس، وليس تدفق مفرط للمواد.

question.en: (Sanding Marks) After painting, fine, parallel lines are visible in the topcoat that match the scratches from the coarse sandpaper used to prep the primer. What is this defect?
question.ar: (علامات الصنفرة) بعد الطلاء، تظهر خطوط متوازية دقيقة في الطبقة العلوية تتطابق مع الخدوش الناتجة عن ورق الصنفرة الخشن المستخدم لتحضير البرايمر. ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Cracking
Contour Mapping
Sanding Marks / Sand Scratch Swelling
choices.ar: علامات الصنفرة / تورم خدش الصنفرة (Sanding Marks / Sand Scratch Swelling)

choices.en: Dry Spray

en.plain: Why C is correct: Sanding Marks (or Sand Scratch Swelling) are caused by failing to use a fine enough grit sandpaper before applying the topcoat. The solvents in the new paint swell these coarse scratches, making them visible. It can also be caused by not "stage sanding" (e.g., jumping from 180-grit to 600-grit). Why B is incorrect: Contour Mapping is the visible outline of the entire repair area, not the individual sand scratches. Why A is incorrect: Cracking is a fracture of the paint film. Why D is incorrect: Dry Spray is a texture issue.

  • Why A is incorrect: Cracking is a fracture of the paint film.
  • Why D is incorrect: Dry Spray is a texture issue.

question.en: (Poor Hiding / Show-Through) A technician applies two coats of a red basecoat over a grey primer, but the grey colour is still visible through the red. What is this defect?
question.ar: (ضعف التغطية / الشفافية) يطبق فني طبقتين من طبقة الأساس الحمراء فوق برايمر رمادي، ولكن اللون الرمادي لا يزال مرئيًا من خلال الأحمر. ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Bleeding
Fading
Poor Hiding / Show-Through
Blushing

en.plain: Why C is correct: Poor Hiding (or Show-Through / Transparency) is the inability of a paint to obscure the underlying substrate. This is common with certain pigments (reds, yellows) and is corrected by applying more coats or by using a properly-coloured (tinted) sealer as a ground coat. Why A is incorrect: Bleeding is when the bottom colour seeps up and stains the top colour. Poor hiding is when the top colour isn't opaque enough to cover the bottom colour. Why B is incorrect: Fading is a loss of colour from UV exposure over time. Why D is incorrect: Blushing is a milky appearance from trapped moisture.

  • Why A is incorrect: Bleeding is when the bottom colour seeps up and stains the top colour. Poor hiding is when the top colour isn't opaque enough to cover the bottom colour.
  • Why B is incorrect: Fading is a loss of colour from UV exposure over time.
  • Why D is incorrect: Blushing is a milky appearance from trapped moisture.

ar.plain: لماذا ج صحيح: ضعف التغطية (أو الشفافية / الظهور من خلال) هو عدم قدرة الطلاء على حجب الركيزة السفلية. هذا شائع مع بعض الأصباغ (الأحمر، الأصفر) ويتم تصحيحه بتطبيق المزيد من الطبقات أو باستخدام سيلر ملون (مصبوغ) بشكل صحيح كطبقة أرضية. لماذا أ غير صحيح: النزيف هو عندما يتسرب اللون السفلي لأعلى ويلطخ اللون العلوي. ضعف التغطية هو عندما لا يكون اللون العلوي معتمًا بما يكفي لتغطية اللون السفلي. لماذا ب غير صحيح: البهتان هو فقدان اللون بسبب التعرض للأشعة فوق البنفسجية بمرور الوقت. لماذا د غير صحيح: الابيضاض هو مظهر حليبي ناتج عن الرطوبة المحتبسة.

question.en: (Solvent Popping) A technician sprays a second coat of clear too soon, without letting the first coat flash. After baking, the finish is covered in tiny blisters and "popped" craters. What is this defect?
question.ar: (فرقعة المذيب) يرش فني طبقة ثانية من الورنيش الشفاف قريبًا جدًا، دون ترك الطبقة الأولى تجف سطحيًا. بعد الخبز، يغطى الطلاء النهائي ببثور صغيرة وفوهات "مفرقعة". ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Fish Eyes
Pinholes
Dirt Nibs
Solvent Popping

en.plain: Why D is correct: Solvent Popping (or boiling/gassing) occurs when solvents from an under-layer get trapped by a new layer that has "skinned" over. When heated (like in a bake cycle), these trapped solvents boil, and the gas "pops" through the surface, leaving a blister or crater. It is caused by insufficient flash time or applying coats too heavily. Why A is incorrect: Fish Eyes are caused by surface contamination repelling the paint. Why B is incorrect: Pinholes are voids in body filler or primer from trapped air. Why C is incorrect: Dirt Nibs are particles of dust on the paint, not blisters from within the paint.

richText.content:
• Why D is correct: Solvent Popping (or boiling/gassing) occurs when solvents from an under-layer get trapped by a new layer that has "skinned" over. When heated (like in a bake cycle), these trapped solvents boil, and the gas "pops" through the surface, leaving a blister or crater. It is caused by insufficient flash time or applying coats too heavily.

  • Why B is incorrect: Pinholes are voids in body filler or primer from trapped air.
  • Why C is incorrect: Dirt Nibs are particles of dust on the paint, not blisters from within the paint.

question.en: (Wrinkling) A technician applies a new coat of paint over an old enamel finish that was not fully cured. The new paint surface shrivels and develops a "prune-like" texture. What is this defect?
question.ar: (التجعد) يطبق فني طبقة جديدة من الطلاء فوق طلاء مينا قديم لم يكن معالجًا بالكامل. يتقلص سطح الطلاء الجديد ويتطور إلى نسيج "يشبه البرقوق". ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Lifting
Cracking
Wrinkling
Orange Peel

en.plain: Why C is correct: Wrinkling (or crinkling) occurs when the new paint's solvents soften the underlying layer, and the new layer dries faster, shrinking and pulling the soft layer beneath it into a shriveled texture. This is common when re-coating an enamel or single-stage paint that is not fully cured. Why A is incorrect: Lifting is a more aggressive, immediate reaction that looks like the paint is shriveling and detaching from the substrate. Wrinkling is more of a surface texture distortion. Why B is incorrect: Cracking is the fracturing of a cured film. Why D is incorrect: Orange Peel is a dimpled texture, not a shriveled one.

question.en: (Polishing Pads) When machine polishing a cured paint finish, which type of pad is the MOST aggressive and is used with a coarse compound to remove deep sand scratches (e.g., 1500-grit)?
question.ar: (وسادات التلميع) عند تلميع طلاء جاف آليًا، أي نوع من الوسادات هو الأكثر قوة ويستخدم مع مركب خشن لإزالة خدوش الصنفرة العميقة (مثل 1500-grit)؟

choices.en: Wool Pad
Light Cutting Foam Pad
choices.ar: وسادة رغوية للقطع الخفيف (Light Cutting Foam Pad)

choices.en: Finishing Foam Pad
Microfiber Pad

en.plain: Why A is correct: A Wool Pad has fibers that provide a very aggressive cut. It is the first step in polishing, used with the coarsest compound to level the surface and remove deep sand scratches (like 1500-grit). Why B is incorrect: A Light Cutting Foam Pad is less aggressive than wool and is typically used as a second step to remove the swirl marks left by the wool pad. Why C is incorrect: A Finishing Foam Pad has no cutting ability and is used only to apply glazes or waxes to restore the final gloss. Why D is incorrect: Microfiber Pads are a modern alternative, but wool is traditionally considered the most aggressive "cutting" pad.

  • Why C is incorrect: A Finishing Foam Pad has no cutting ability and is used only to apply glazes or waxes to restore the final gloss.

question.en: (Polishing Process - Die-Back) A technician polishes a freshly painted panel immediately after it air-dries, and it looks great. The next day, the polished area appears dull again. What is the most likely cause?
question.ar: (عملية التلميع - تراجع اللمعان) يقوم فني بتلميع لوحة مطلية حديثًا فور جفافها في الهواء، وتبدو رائعة. في اليوم التالي، تبدو المنطقة المصقولة باهتة مرة أخرى. ما هو السبب الأكثر احتمالاً؟

choices.en: The technician used the wrong compound.
The technician polished the finish too soon, trapping solvents.
choices.ar: قام الفني بتلميع الطلاء في وقت مبكر جدًا، مما أدى إلى حبس المذيبات.

choices.en: The technician used a wool pad instead of a foam pad.
choices.ar: استخدم الفني وسادة صوف بدلاً من وسادة رغوية.

choices.en: The technician polished at too high an RPM.
choices.ar: قام الفني بالتلميع عند عدد دورات في الدقيقة مرتفع جدًا.

en.plain: Why B is correct: This defect is called Die-Back or "dulling back." Paint cures by releasing solvents for hours or even days. Polishing (buffing) the surface too soon heats and seals the top layer, trapping the remaining solvents. As these solvents slowly escape over the next 24 hours, the paint film shrinks and sinks, causing the polished surface to lose its gloss and appear dull. Why A, C, and D are incorrect: While these can cause their own issues (swirl marks, buffer burns), they do not explain the phenomenon of the gloss "dying back" hours after the buffing is complete. This is a timing and solvent-trapping issue.

Polishing (buffing) the surface too soon heats and seals the top layer, trapping the remaining solvents. As these solvents slowly escape over the next 24 hours, the paint film shrinks and sinks, causing the polished surface to lose its gloss and appear dull.
  • Why A, C, and D are incorrect: While these can cause their own issues (swirl marks, buffer burns), they do not explain the phenomenon of the gloss "dying back" hours after the buffing is complete. This is a timing and solvent-trapping issue.

ar.plain: لماذا ب صحيح: يسمى هذا العيب تراجع اللمعان أو "البهتان الخلفي". يعالج الطلاء عن طريق إطلاق المذيبات لساعات أو حتى أيام. يؤدي تلميع (صقل) السطح في وقت مبكر جدًا إلى تسخين وختم الطبقة العليا، مما يحبس المذيبات المتبقية. مع هروب هذه المذيبات ببطء خلال الـ 24 ساعة التالية، تتقلص طبقة الطلاء وتهبط، مما يتسبب في فقدان السطح المصقول للمعان وظهوره باهتًا. لماذا أ، ج، ود غير صحيحة: على الرغم من أن هذه يمكن أن تسبب مشاكلها الخاصة (علامات دوامات، حروق الصقل)، إلا أنها لا تفسر ظاهرة "تراجع" اللمعان بعد ساعات من اكتمال الصقل. هذه مشكلة توقيت وحبس مذيبات.

question.en: (Pad Cleaning) What is the correct tool to use for cleaning caked, dried-on compound from a wool polishing pad?
question.ar: (تنظيف الوسادة) ما هي الأداة الصحيحة لاستخدامها لتنظيف مركب التلميع المتكتل والجاف من وسادة تلميع صوفية؟

choices.en: A stiff-bristled brush
A spur cleaning tool
A screwdriver
A solvent-soaked rag

en.plain: Why B is correct: A spur cleaning tool has rotating metal wheels designed to "fluff" the wool fibers and rake out the dried compound while the buffer is spinning (at a low, safe speed). Why A is incorrect: A stiff-bristled brush is the correct tool for cleaning a foam pad. Using a spur on a foam pad would destroy it. Why C & D are incorrect: These are improper and unsafe methods for cleaning a pad.

richText.content:
• Why B is correct: A spur cleaning tool has rotating metal wheels designed to "fluff" the wool fibers and rake out the dried compound while the buffer is spinning (at a low, safe speed).
  • Why A is incorrect: A stiff-bristled brush is the correct tool for cleaning a foam pad. Using a spur on a foam pad would destroy it.
  • Why C & D are incorrect: These are improper and unsafe methods for cleaning a pad.

question.en: (Polishing Process - Swirl Marks) After compounding a panel with a wool pad, the finish is glossy but covered in fine, circular scratches that are visible in direct light. What are these defects called?
question.ar: (عملية التلميع - علامات الدوامات) بعد صقل لوحة بوسادة صوف، يكون الطلاء لامعًا ولكنه مغطى بخدوش دائرية دقيقة مرئية في الضوء المباشر. ماذا تسمى هذه العيوب؟

choices.en: Holograms
Swirl Marks
Sand Scratches
Lifting

en.plain: Why B is correct: Swirl Marks are very fine, circular scratches left by the abrasive action of a coarse compound and a cutting pad (like wool). They are a normal byproduct of the first "cutting" step of polishing. Why A is incorrect: Holograms are a specific, hazy "buffer trail" defect, whereas swirl marks are distinct circular scratches. Why C is incorrect: Sand Scratches are the deeper, initial scratches (e.g., 1500-grit) that the compound is meant to remove . Swirls are the result of the compounding. Why D is incorrect: Lifting is a paint reaction defect.

richText.content:
• Why B is correct: Swirl Marks are very fine, circular scratches left by the abrasive action of a coarse compound and a cutting pad (like wool). They are a normal byproduct of the first "cutting" step of polishing.
  • Why A is incorrect: Holograms are a specific, hazy "buffer trail" defect, whereas swirl marks are distinct circular scratches.
  • Why C is incorrect: Sand Scratches are the deeper, initial scratches (e.g., 1500-grit) that the compound is meant to remove. Swirls are the result of the compounding.
  • Why D is incorrect: Lifting is a paint reaction defect.

  • لماذا ج غير صحيح: خدوش الصنفرة هي الخدوش الأولية الأعمق (مثل 1500-grit) التي يُفترض بالمركب أن يزيلها. الدوامات هي نتيجة لعملية الصقل.

question.en: (Polishing Process - Holograms) After polishing with a rotary buffer, the paint surface shows a "buffer trail" or "hologram" effect, especially on dark colours. What is the primary cause of this?
question.ar: (عملية التلميع - الصور ثلاثية الأبعاد) بعد التلميع بملمع دوار، يُظهر سطح الطلاء "أثر الملمع" أو تأثير "الصورة ثلاثية الأبعاد"، خاصة على الألوان الداكنة. ما هو السبب الرئيسي لهذا؟

choices.en: Using a wool pad with a coarse compound.
choices.ar: استخدام وسادة صوف مع مركب خشن.

choices.en: Using a Dual-Action (DA) polisher.
Improper buffer motion (e.g., tilting the pad, moving too fast).
choices.ar: حركة ملمع غير صحيحة (مثل إمالة الوسادة، التحرك بسرعة كبيرة).

choices.en: The clearcoat being too soft.
choices.ar: كون طبقة الورنيش الشفاف ناعمة جدًا.

en.plain: Why C is correct: Holograms (or buffer trails) are a hazy, streaky pattern that mimics the path of the buffer. They are caused by improper use of a rotary buffer, such as tilting the pad on its edge, moving the buffer too quickly across the panel, or not keeping the pad flat. Why A is incorrect: While a wool pad leaves swirls, holograms are a result of technique , not just the pad itself. Why B is incorrect: A Dual-Action (DA) polisher oscillates, which specifically prevents the creation of holograms. Why D is incorrect: Soft clearcoat is not the direct cause.

  • Why A is incorrect: While a wool pad leaves swirls, holograms are a result of technique, not just the pad itself.
  • Why B is incorrect: A Dual-Action (DA) polisher oscillates, which specifically prevents the creation of holograms.
  • Why D is incorrect: Soft clearcoat is not the direct cause.

ar.plain: لماذا ج صحيح: الصور ثلاثية الأبعاد (أو آثار الملمع) هي نمط ضبابي ومخطط يحاكي مسار الملمع. تحدث بسبب الاستخدام غير الصحيح للملمع الدوار ، مثل إمالة الوسادة على حافتها، أو تحريك الملمع بسرعة كبيرة عبر اللوحة، أو عدم إبقاء الوسادة مسطحة. لماذا أ غير صحيح: بينما تترك وسادة الصوف دوامات، فإن الصور ثلاثية الأبعاد هي نتيجة للتقنية ، وليس فقط الوسادة نفسها. لماذا ب غير صحيح: الملمع مزدوج الحركة (DA) يتذبذب، وهو ما يمنع تحديدًا تكوين الصور ثلاثية الأبعاد. لماذا د غير صحيح: طبقة الورنيش الشفاف الناعمة ليست السبب المباشر.

question.en: (Polishing Process - Glaze/Filler) What is the main purpose of using a "glaze" or "filler-polish" as a final step in detailing?
question.ar: (عملية التلميع - المُلمع/الحشو) ما هو الغرض الرئيسي من استخدام "مُلمع" أو "ملمع حشو" كخطوة أخيرة في التلميع؟

choices.en: To permanently remove all deep scratches.
choices.ar: لإزالة جميع الخدوش العميقة بشكل دائم.

choices.en: To add a durable, long-lasting layer of protection.
choices.ar: لإضافة طبقة حماية متينة وطويلة الأمد.

choices.en: To temporarily fill and hide minor swirl marks and enhance gloss.
choices.ar: لملء وإخفاء علامات الدوامات الطفيفة مؤقتًا وتعزيز اللمعان.

choices.en: To chemically strip old wax from the paint.
choices.ar: لإزالة الشمع القديم كيميائيًا من الطلاء.

en.plain: Why C is correct: Glazes and filler-polishes contain oils and resins that fill microscopic scratches (like swirl marks), making the surface appear perfectly smooth and glossy. This is a temporary fix, as the fillers will wash away over time, re-exposing the swirls. Why A is incorrect: They hide scratches, they do not remove them. Only abrasive compounds and polishes remove scratches. Why B is incorrect: Glazes offer very little, if any, protection. A wax or sealant must be applied after the glaze. Why D is incorrect: They add oils to the paint; they do not strip anything.

• Why C is correct: Glazes and filler-polishes contain oils and resins that fill microscopic scratches (like swirl marks), making the surface appear perfectly smooth and glossy. This is a temporary fix, as the fillers will wash away over time, re-exposing the swirls.
  • Why A is incorrect: They hide scratches, they do not remove them. Only abrasive compounds and polishes remove scratches.
  • Why B is incorrect: Glazes offer very little, if any, protection. A wax or sealant must be applied after the glaze.
  • Why D is incorrect: They add oils to the paint; they do not strip anything.

ar.plain: لماذا ج صحيح: تحتوي المُلمعات وملمعات الحشو على زيوت وراتنجات تملأ الخدوش المجهرية (مثل علامات الدوامات)، مما يجعل السطح يبدو أملسًا ولامعًا تمامًا. هذا إصلاح مؤقت ، حيث ستزول الحشوات مع الغسيل بمرور الوقت، مما يعيد كشف الدوامات. لماذا أ غير صحيح: هي تخفي الخدوش، ولا تزيلها . فقط المركبات والملمعات الكاشطة هي التي تزيل الخدوش. لماذا ب غير صحيح: توفر المُلمعات حماية قليلة جدًا، إن وجدت. يجب تطبيق شمع أو مانع تسرب بعد المُلمع. لماذا د غير صحيح: هي تضيف زيوتًا إلى الطلاء؛ ولا تزيل أي شيء.

question.en: (Defect Repair - Dirt Nibs) What is the correct method to repair a "dirt nib" in a fully cured clearcoat?
question.ar: (إصلاح العيوب - نتوءات الأوساخ) ما هي الطريقة الصحيحة لإصلاح "نتوء الأوساخ" في طبقة ورنيش شفاف معالجة بالكامل؟

choices.en: Compound the nib with a wool pad until it is level.
choices.ar: صقل النتوء بوسادة صوف حتى يصبح مستويًا.

choices.en: Immediately re-spray the entire panel.
choices.ar: إعادة رش اللوحة بأكملها على الفور.

choices.en: Carefully sand the nib flat (e.g., 1500-2000 grit), then compound and polish the area.
choices.ar: صنفرة النتوء بعناية ليصبح مسطحًا (مثل 1500-2000 grit)، ثم صقل وتلميع المنطقة.

choices.en: Wipe the nib with a solvent-soaked rag to dissolve it.
choices.ar: مسح النتوء بقطعة قماش مبللة بالمذيب لإذابته.

en.plain: Why C is correct: This is the standard "finessing" process. The raised nib is carefully sanded level with the surrounding clearcoat using a small block and fine-grit sandpaper. This leaves a small, dull, sanded area, which is then restored to full gloss by compounding and polishing. Why A is incorrect: Compounding alone cannot level a hard dirt nib; it will just polish the top of the nib and the area around it. Why B is incorrect: Re-spraying the panel is a last resort and massive overkill for a small dirt nib. Why D is incorrect: Solvent will not dissolve a cured dirt nib and may damage the surrounding paint.

richText.content:
• Why C is correct: This is the standard "finessing" process. The raised nib is carefully sanded level with the surrounding clearcoat using a small block and fine-grit sandpaper. This leaves a small, dull, sanded area, which is then restored to full gloss by compounding and polishing.
  • Why A is incorrect: Compounding alone cannot level a hard dirt nib; it will just polish the top of the nib and the area around it.
  • Why B is incorrect: Re-spraying the panel is a last resort and massive overkill for a small dirt nib.
  • Why D is incorrect: Solvent will not dissolve a cured dirt nib and may damage the surrounding paint.

ar.plain: لماذا ج صحيح: هذه هي عملية "التنقية" القياسية. يتم صنفرة النتوء المرتفع بعناية ليتساوى مع طبقة الورنيش الشفاف المحيطة باستخدام بلوك صغير وورق صنفرة ناعم الحبيبات. هذا يترك منطقة صغيرة باهتة ومصنفرة، والتي يتم بعد ذلك استعادة لمعانها الكامل عن طريق الصقل والتلميع. لماذا أ غير صحيح: لا يمكن للصقل وحده تسوية نتوء أوساخ صلب؛ سيقوم فقط بتلميع قمة النتوء والمنطقة المحيطة به. لماذا ب غير صحيح: إعادة رش اللوحة هو الملاذ الأخير وهو مبالغة هائلة لنتوء أوساخ صغير. لماذا د غير صحيح: لن يذيب المذيب نتوء أوساخ معالج وقد يتلف الطلاء المحيط.

  • لماذا ب غير صحيح: إعادة رش اللوحة هو الملاذ الأخير وهو مبالغة هائلة لنتوء أوساخ صغير.

question.en: (Defect Repair - Overspray) What is the LEAST aggressive method for removing light paint overspray from the undamaged, cured clearcoat of an adjacent panel?
question.ar: (إصلاح العيوب - الرش الزائد) ما هي الطريقة الأقل قسوة لإزالة رذاذ الطلاء الخفيف من طبقة الورنيش الشفاف غير التالفة والمعالجة للوحة مجاورة؟

choices.en: Wet sand with 2000-grit paper.
Use a clay bar with lubricant.
choices.ar: استخدام شريط الصلصال (clay bar) مع مزلق.

choices.en: Polish with a wool pad and coarse compound.
Wipe with lacquer thinner.

en.plain: Why B is correct: A clay bar is a non-abrasive material designed to glide over the surface with a lubricant and "grab" or shear off surface contaminants (like overspray) without scratching or removing the clearcoat itself. Why A & C are incorrect: Wet sanding and coarse compounding are much more aggressive. They will remove the overspray, but they will also remove a layer of the clearcoat, which is unnecessary. Why D is incorrect: Lacquer thinner is a strong solvent that can soften and damage the cured clearcoat.

richText.content:
• Why B is correct: A clay bar is a non-abrasive material designed to glide over the surface with a lubricant and "grab" or shear off surface contaminants (like overspray) without scratching or removing the clearcoat itself.
  • Why A & C are incorrect: Wet sanding and coarse compounding are much more aggressive. They will remove the overspray, but they will also remove a layer of the clearcoat, which is unnecessary.
  • Why D is incorrect: Lacquer thinner is a strong solvent that can soften and damage the cured clearcoat.

ar.plain: لماذا ب صحيح: شريط الصلصال هو مادة غير كاشطة مصممة للانزلاق فوق السطح مع مزلق و "التقاط" أو قص ملوثات السطح (مثل الرش الزائد) دون خدش أو إزالة طبقة الورنيش الشفاف نفسها. لماذا أ و ج غير صحيحين: الصنفرة الرطبة والصقل الخشن أكثر قسوة بكثير. ستزيل الرذاذ الزائد، ولكنها ستزيل أيضًا طبقة من الورنيش الشفاف، وهو أمر غير ضروري. لماذا د غير صحيح: مخفف الطلاء (ثنر) هو مذيب قوي يمكن أن يلين ويتلف طبقة الورنيش الشفاف المعالجة.

question.en: (Defect Repair - Runs) How is a "run" or "sag" in a fully cured clearcoat typically repaired?
question.ar: (إصلاح العيوب - السيلان) كيف يتم إصلاح "السيلان" أو "الترهل" في طبقة ورنيش شفاف معالجة بالكامل عادةً؟

choices.en: By carefully sanding the run flat (using a block or nib file), then compounding and polishing.
choices.ar: عن طريق صنفرة السيلان بعناية ليصبح مسطحًا (باستخدام بلوك أو مبرد نتوءات)، ثم الصقل والتلميع.

choices.en: By wiping the run with solvent until it dissolves.
choices.ar: عن طريق مسح السيلان بالمذيب حتى يذوب.

choices.en: By re-clearing the entire panel over the top of the run.
choices.ar: عن طريق إعادة رش طبقة ورنيش شفاف على اللوحة بأكملها فوق السيلان.

choices.en: By heating the run with a heat gun until it flows out.
choices.ar: عن طريق تسخين السيلان بمسدس حراري حتى يتدفق.

en.plain: Why A is correct: The goal is to level the excess material. A run is sanded down (often with a "nib file" or a small, hard block and fine-grit paper) until it is flush with the surrounding paint. This leaves a dull, sanded area that must then be compounded and polished to restore gloss. Why B is incorrect: Solvent will not work on cured paint and will damage the finish. Why C is incorrect: Applying more clearcoat will just bury the run, making it look even worse. Why D is incorrect: Heat will not flow out a cured 2K clearcoat.

richText.content:
• Why A is correct: The goal is to level the excess material. A run is sanded down (often with a "nib file" or a small, hard block and fine-grit paper) until it is flush with the surrounding paint. This leaves a dull, sanded area that must then be compounded and polished to restore gloss.
  • Why B is incorrect: Solvent will not work on cured paint and will damage the finish.
  • Why C is incorrect: Applying more clearcoat will just bury the run, making it look even worse.
  • Why D is incorrect: Heat will not flow out a cured 2K clearcoat.

ar.plain: لماذا أ صحيح: الهدف هو تسوية المادة الزائدة. يتم صنفرة السيلان (غالبًا بـ "مبرد نتوءات" أو بلوك صلب صغير وورق صنفرة ناعم) حتى يصبح مستويًا مع الطلاء المحيط. هذا يترك منطقة باهتة ومصنفرة يجب بعد ذلك صقلها وتلميعها لاستعادة اللمعان. لماذا ب غير صحيح: لن يعمل المذيب على الطلاء المعالج وسيتلف الطلاء النهائي. لماذا ج غير صحيح: تطبيق المزيد من الورنيش الشفاف سيدفن السيلان فقط، مما يجعله يبدو أسوأ. لماذا د غير صحيح: لن تؤدي الحرارة إلى تدفق طبقة ورنيش شفاف 2K معالجة.

question.en: (Defect Repair - Orange Peel) To repair heavy orange peel in a cured clearcoat, what is the standard process?
question.ar: (إصلاح العيوب - قشر البرتقال) لإصلاح قشر البرتقال الكثيف في طبقة ورنيش شفاف معالجة، ما هي العملية القياسية؟

choices.en: Wet sand the entire panel (e.g., 1500-grit) to level the texture, then compound and polish.
choices.ar: صنفرة رطبة للوحة بأكملها (مثل 1500-grit) لتسوية النسيج، ثم الصقل والتلميع.

choices.en: Apply a "flow coat" of more clearcoat to melt the orange peel.
choices.ar: تطبيق "طبقة تدفق" من المزيد من الورنيش الشفاف لإذابة قشر البرتقال.

choices.en: Polish with a finishing pad and glaze.
Use a clay bar and lubricant.

en.plain: Why A is correct: Orange peel consists of "hills" and "valleys." The only way to remove it is to sand the "hills" down until the entire surface is uniformly flat and level (it will appear dull and hazy). This is done with fine-grit sandpaper (1500, 2000, or 3000-grit). This flat, dull surface is then brought back to a high gloss by compounding and polishing. Why B is incorrect: A "flow coat" is a technique used *during* application, not a repair for cured orange peel. Why C & D are incorrect: Polishing and clay bars will only smooth the *top* of the orange peel "hills" and will not level the texture.

richText.content:
• Why A is correct: Orange peel consists of "hills" and "valleys." The only way to remove it is to sand the "hills" down until the entire surface is uniformly flat and level (it will appear dull and hazy). This is done with fine-grit sandpaper (1500, 2000, or 3000-grit). This flat, dull surface is then brought back to a high gloss by compounding and polishing.
  • Why B is incorrect: A "flow coat" is a technique used *during* application, not a repair for cured orange peel.
  • Why C & D are incorrect: Polishing and clay bars will only smooth the *top* of the orange peel "hills" and will not level the texture.

ar.plain: لماذا أ صحيح: يتكون قشر البرتقال من "تلال" و "وديان". الطريقة الوحيدة لإزالته هي صنفرة "التلال" لأسفل حتى يصبح السطح بأكمله مسطحًا ومستويًا بشكل موحد (سيظهر باهتًا وضبابيًا). يتم ذلك بورق صنفرة ناعم الحبيبات (1500، 2000، أو 3000-grit). يتم بعد ذلك إعادة هذا السطح المسطح والباهت إلى لمعان عالٍ عن طريق الصقل والتلميع. لماذا ب غير صحيح: "طبقة التدفق" هي تقنية تستخدم *أثناء* التطبيق، وليست إصلاحًا لقشر البرتقال المعالج. لماذا ج و د غير صحيحين: التلميع وأشرطة الصلصال ستعمل فقط على تنعيم *قمة* "تلال" قشر البرتقال ولن تسوي النسيج.

question.en: (Defect Repair - Fish Eye) How must a "fish eye" crater be repaired after the paint has cured?
question.ar: (إصلاح العيوب - عين السمكة) كيف يجب إصلاح فوهة "عين السمكة" بعد معالجة الطلاء؟

choices.en: Polish with coarse compound until the crater disappears.
choices.ar: صقل بمركب خشن حتى تختفي الفوهة.

choices.en: Sand the crater and surrounding area, re-clean, re-apply basecoat if needed, and re-clear.
choices.ar: صنفرة الفوهة والمنطقة المحيطة بها، وإعادة التنظيف، وإعادة تطبيق طبقة الأساس إذا لزم الأمر، وإعادة تطبيق الورنيش الشفاف.

choices.en: Fill the crater with clear touch-up paint.
Apply a glaze over the crater to hide it.

en.plain: Why B is correct: A fish eye is a crater where the paint has pulled away, often exposing the layer beneath. It must be treated as a full defect. The entire area must be sanded smooth (to remove the crater ridge), thoroughly re-cleaned (to remove the original contamination), and then the paint process (basecoat and/or clearcoat) must be re-applied. Why A is incorrect: Polishing will not remove a crater. Why C & D are incorrect: Filling the crater will leave a visible mark and does not address the contamination or the ring around the crater.

ar.plain: لماذا ب صحيح: عين السمكة هي فوهة انسحب الطلاء منها، كاشفًا غالبًا عن الطبقة السفلية. يجب معاملتها كعيب كامل. يجب صنفرة المنطقة بأكملها لتصبح ناعمة (لإزالة حافة الفوهة)، وإعادة تنظيفها تمامًا (لإزالة التلوث الأصلي)، ثم يجب إعادة تطبيق عملية الطلاء (طبقة الأساس و/أو الورنيش الشفاف). لماذا أ غير صحيح: لن يزيل الصقل فوهة. لماذا ج و د غير صحيحين: ملء الفوهة سيترك علامة مرئية ولا يعالج التلوث أو الحلقة حول الفوهة.

question.en: (Defect Repair - Sand Scratch Swelling) A technician sees sand scratches showing through the clearcoat *after* it has cured. How must this be repaired?
question.ar: (إصلاح العيوب - تورم خدش الصنفرة) يرى فني خدوش صنفرة تظهر من خلال طبقة الورنيش الشفاف *بعد* معالجتها. كيف يجب إصلاح هذا؟

choices.en: Polish the surface until the scratches disappear.
Apply another coat of clearcoat over the top.
choices.ar: تطبيق طبقة أخرى من الورنيش الشفاف فوقها.

choices.en: Sand the panel back down to the primer, apply more primer-surfacer, sand properly, and re-paint.
choices.ar: صنفرة اللوحة مرة أخرى حتى البرايمر، وتطبيق المزيد من البرايمر-السيرفيسر، والصنفرة بشكل صحيح، وإعادة الطلاء.

choices.en: Apply a heavy coat of glaze to fill the scratches.
choices.ar: تطبيق طبقة سميكة من المُلمع لملء الخدوش.

en.plain: Why C is correct: This defect means the scratches were too deep in the primer layer and were not properly filled or removed. The topcoat has "sunk" into them. There is no way to fix this from the top. The topcoat has failed, and the only correct repair is to remove the paint, fix the underlying substrate (the primer) correctly, and start the paint process over. Why A, B, and D are incorrect: Polishing, adding more clear, or applying glaze are all surface-level fixes that will not hide deep scratches that are "mapping" through from the primer layer.

ar.plain: لماذا ج صحيح: يعني هذا العيب أن الخدوش كانت عميقة جدًا في طبقة البرايمر ولم يتم ملؤها أو إزالتها بشكل صحيح. لقد "هبطت" الطبقة العلوية فيها. لا توجد طريقة لإصلاح هذا من الأعلى. لقد فشلت الطبقة العلوية، والإصلاح الصحيح الوحيد هو إزالة الطلاء، وإصلاح الركيزة السفلية (البرايمر) بشكل صحيح، وبدء عملية الطلاء من جديد. لماذا أ، ب، ود غير صحيحة: التلميع، أو إضافة المزيد من الورنيش الشفاف، أو تطبيق المُلمع كلها إصلاحات سطحية لن تخفي الخدوش العميقة التي "تظهر" من خلال طبقة البرايمر.

question.en: (Polishing - Buffer Burns) A technician holds a rotary buffer on an edge or body line for too long, and the paint turns brown, smells burnt, and wears through. What is this defect?
question.ar: (التلميع - حروق الملمع) يمسك فني ملمع دوار على حافة أو خط هيكل لفترة طويلة جدًا، فيتحول لون الطلاء إلى البني، وتفوح منه رائحة احتراق، ويتآكل. ما هو هذا العيب؟

choices.en: Buffer Burn
Swirl Marks
Die-Back
Holograms

en.plain: Why A is correct: A Buffer Burn is caused by the extreme friction and heat generated by a rotary buffer (especially a wool pad) held in one place for too long. This heat literally burns and melts the paint, often wearing right through the clearcoat and basecoat to the primer below. Why B & D are incorrect: Swirl Marks and Holograms are fine scratches or haze, not destructive heat damage. Why C is incorrect: Die-Back is a loss of gloss from trapped solvents, not friction heat.

  • Why B & D are incorrect: Swirl Marks and Holograms are fine scratches or haze, not destructive heat damage.
  • Why C is incorrect: Die-Back is a loss of gloss from trapped solvents, not friction heat.

ar.plain: لماذا أ صحيح: يحدث حرق الملمع بسبب الاحتكاك الشديد والحرارة الناتجة عن ملمع دوار (خاصة وسادة صوف) يتم إمساكه في مكان واحد لفترة طويلة جدًا. هذه الحرارة تحرق وتذيب الطلاء حرفيًا، وغالبًا ما تتآكل عبر طبقة الورنيش الشفاف وطبقة الأساس وصولاً إلى البرايمر أدناه. لماذا ب و د غير صحيحين: علامات الدوامات و الصور ثلاثية الأبعاد هي خدوش دقيقة أو ضباب، وليست ضررًا حراريًا مدمرًا. لماذا ج غير صحيح: تراجع اللمعان هو فقدان اللمعان بسبب المذيبات المحتبسة، وليس حرارة الاحتكاك.

question.en: (Polishing - Final Step) What is the final step after all compounding and polishing is complete to remove residues and inspect the finish?
question.ar: (التلميع - الخطوة الأخيرة) ما هي الخطوة الأخيرة بعد اكتمال جميع عمليات الصقل والتلميع لإزالة البقايا وفحص الطلاء النهائي؟

choices.en: Wipe with a clean, soft microfiber towel (sometimes with a final-wipe spray or alcohol/water mix).
choices.ar: المسح بمنشفة من الألياف الدقيقة نظيفة وناعمة (أحيانًا مع رذاذ مسح نهائي أو مزيج كحول/ماء).

choices.en: Wash the entire car with coarse soap and water.
choices.ar: غسل السيارة بأكملها بالصابون الخشن والماء.

choices.en: Apply a layer of spray-on body filler.
choices.ar: تطبيق طبقة من معجون الهيكل بالرش.

choices.en: Sand the entire panel with 3000-grit paper.

en.plain: Why A is correct: After polishing, the surface is covered in oily, abrasive residues. A clean, soft microfiber towel is required to safely wipe these residues away without scratching the newly perfected finish. A final-wipe spray (cleaner) is often used to ensure all oils are removed, allowing for a true, accurate inspection of the finish. Why B is incorrect: Washing with soap can leave its own residue and is not the correct inspection step. Why C is incorrect: Body filler is a repair product, not a cleaning step. Why D is incorrect: Sanding is the first step (to remove defects), not the final step.

  • Why C is incorrect: Body filler is a repair product, not a cleaning step.
  • Why D is incorrect: Sanding is the first step (to remove defects), not the final step.

question.en: An approved _______ schedule is required when using organic vapour cartridges.
question.ar: مطلوب جدول _______ معتمد عند استخدام خراطيش البخار العضوي.

choices.en: maintenance
change-out
cleaning
fit-test

en.plain: Why B is correct: The module explains that organic vapour cartridges have a limited lifespan as the activated charcoal becomes saturated. They cannot be cleaned. Therefore, an employer must establish a "change-out schedule" based on air quality testing to ensure cartridges are replaced *before* they stop offering protection. Why A and C are incorrect: Cartridges are disposable and cannot be "maintained" or "cleaned." Why D is incorrect: A "fit-test" is a separate requirement to ensure the respirator mask forms a proper seal with the user's face, not the schedule for replacing cartridges.

  • Why A and C are incorrect: Cartridges are disposable and cannot be "maintained" or "cleaned."
  • Why D is incorrect: A "fit-test" is a separate requirement to ensure the respirator mask forms a proper seal with the user's face, not the schedule for replacing cartridges.

question.en: Urethane hardeners contain _______, which are carcinogenic; therefore, OHS requires shops to be equipped with fresh-air respiratory protection.
question.ar: تحتوي مصلبات اليوريثان على _______، وهي مواد مسرطنة؛ لذلك، يتطلب قانون OHS تزويد الورش بحماية تنفسية بالهواء النقي.

choices.en: polyolefins
methyl ethyl ketone peroxide (MEKP)
isocyanates
phosphoric acid

en.plain: Why C is correct: The module explicitly identifies isocyanates as the hazardous chemical in 2-component (2K) urethane hardeners. Isocyanates are potent respiratory sensitizers and carcinogens, mandating fresh-air (supplied-air) systems. Why A is incorrect: Polyolefins are a type of thermoplastic plastic (like TPO) used for parts. Why B is incorrect: MEKP is a peroxide catalyst for polyester resins (body filler). Why D is incorrect: Phosphoric acid is the active ingredient in self-etch primers.

  • Why A is incorrect: Polyolefins are a type of thermoplastic plastic (like TPO) used for parts.
  • Why B is incorrect: MEKP is a peroxide catalyst for polyester resins (body filler).
  • Why D is incorrect: Phosphoric acid is the active ingredient in self-etch primers.

question.en: Water-based cleaners should be applied to the _______ when cleaning a panel.
question.ar: يجب تطبيق المنظفات ذات الأساس المائي على _______ عند تنظيف اللوحة.

choices.en: panel directly
panel with a pump bottle
lint-free towel
panel with a spray gun

en.plain: Why C is correct: The module states that water-based cleaners should be applied to a clean lint-free shop towel , which is then used to wipe the panel. This controls the application and prevents contamination from the cleaner drying on the surface. Why A, B, and D are incorrect: Applying water-based cleaners directly to the panel is not the recommended procedure.

question.en: When straining or filtering solvent-based products, which filter (rated in microns) is typically used?
question.ar: عند تصفية أو ترشيح المنتجات القائمة على المذيبات، ما هو الفلتر (المصنف بالميكرون) المستخدم عادةً؟

en.plain: Why B is correct: The module specifies that 200μ (micron) filters are typically used for "all other products," which includes solvent-based primers, sealers, and clearcoats. Why A is incorrect: The 125μ filter is noted for *some waterborne basecoats*, which require finer straining. Why C and D are incorrect: These filter sizes are too coarse for refinish materials.

question.en: Which of the three basic compressor types works on the principle of positive displacement?

en.plain: Why D is correct: All three compressor types (Piston, Rotary Screw, Diaphragm) work by trapping a volume of air in a chamber and then reducing that chamber's volume to increase pressure, which is the definition of positive displacement . question.en: How does a refrigerated drier remove moisture from air lines?
question.ar: كيف يزيل مجفف الهواء المبرد الرطوبة من خطوط الهواء؟

choices.en: By absorbing moisture using a desiccant material.
choices.ar: عن طريق امتصاص الرطوبة باستخدام مادة مجففة.

choices.en: By spinning the air to separate water through centrifugal force.
choices.ar: عن طريق تدوير الهواء لفصل الماء بقوة الطرد المركزي.

choices.en: By cooling the air, which forces water vapour to condense into a liquid.
choices.ar: عن طريق تبريد الهواء، مما يجبر بخار الماء على التكثف إلى سائل.

choices.en: By heating the air to evaporate all water vapour.
choices.ar: عن طريق تسخين الهواء لتبخير كل بخار الماء.

en.plain: Why C is correct: Refrigerated air dryers work by cooling the compressed air in a heat exchanger. This cooling forces the water vapour (humidity) in the air to condense into liquid water, which is then separated and drained. Why A is incorrect: This describes a desiccant dryer . Why B is incorrect: This describes a water separator or filter. Why D is incorrect: Heating air would allow it to hold *more* moisture, not remove it.

en.plain: Why B is correct: Sprayout cards are the most accurate way to confirm a colour match because they show the *actual* result of the mixed paint when sprayed with the shop's equipment. en.plain: Why B is correct: FIFO (First In, First Out) is a stock rotation principle. It means you must use the oldest stock (the "First In") before using the newer stock (making it the "First Out"). question.en: What must be done to a solvent container when transferring to another container to prevent a fire?
question.ar: ما الذي يجب عمله لحاوية المذيب عند النقل إلى حاوية أخرى لمنع نشوب حريق؟

en.plain: Why B is correct: The module explicitly states, "Always ground the containers when transferring flammable liquids ." This (along with bonding) prevents static electricity from building up and causing a spark, which could ignite the flammable vapours. en.plain: Why B is correct: The correct sequence is: Blow off dust, wipe with solvent cleaner (C), allow solvent to flash, then, as the very final step, wipe gently with a tack cloth ( Tacking ) to remove the last traces of dust/lint immediately before spraying. question.en: How should a paint respirator be stored?
question.ar: كيف يجب تخزين جهاز التنفس الخاص بالطلاء؟

choices.en: In an airtight bag
On a wall hook
In a paint bench drawer
On top of a paint cabinet

en.plain: Why A is correct: Respirators, especially those with cartridges, must be stored in an airtight bag or container when not in use. This protects the cartridges from absorbing contaminants from the ambient shop air, which would saturate them and shorten their life. Why B, C, and D are incorrect: Storing a respirator in the open shop air (on a hook, in a drawer, or on a cabinet) exposes the cartridges to continuous contamination.

question.en: Paint product mixing instructions can always be found on the manufacturer's:
question.ar: يمكن دائمًا العثور على تعليمات خلط منتج الطلاء على:

choices.en: Safety data sheets
Paint and solvent can label
Paint colour book
Technical data sheets

en.plain: Why D is correct: The Technical Data Sheet (TDS) is the manufacturer's official instruction manual for a product. It contains all critical mixing ratios, compatible components, and application procedures. Why A is incorrect: Safety Data Sheets (SDS) contain health and safety information, not mixing instructions. Why B is incorrect: The can label has basic warnings and may have simple ratios, but the full, detailed instructions are on the TDS. Why C is incorrect: A colour book is for identifying colour, not mixing.

  • Why B is incorrect: The can label has basic warnings and may have simple ratios, but the full, detailed instructions are on the TDS.
  • Why C is incorrect: A colour book is for identifying colour, not mixing.

en.plain: Why B is correct: FIFO (First In, First Out) is a stock rotation principle. It means you must use the oldest stock (the "First In") before using the newer stock (making it the "First Out"). This is critical for products with a shelf life, like paint hardeners. Why A, C, and D are incorrect: These are incorrect expansions of the acronym.

question.en: Who is responsible for inventory control?
question.ar: من المسؤول عن مراقبة المخزون؟

choices.en: The shop manager
The paint supplier
The head painter
Everyone

en.plain: Why D is correct: Inventory control is "everyone's responsibility." While a manager or head painter may place orders, everyone who uses materials is responsible for noting low stock, rotating items (FIFO), and minimizing waste. Why A, B, and C are incorrect: The responsibility is shared by all, not limited to one role.

richText.content:
• Why D is correct: Inventory control is "everyone's responsibility." While a manager or head painter may place orders, everyone who uses materials is responsible for noting low stock, rotating items (FIFO), and minimizing waste.
  • Why A, B, and C are incorrect: The responsibility is shared by all, not limited to one role.

ar.plain: لماذا د صحيح: مراقبة المخزون هي "مسؤولية الجميع". بينما قد يقوم المدير أو رئيس فنيي الطلاء بتقديم الطلبات، فإن كل من يستخدم المواد مسؤول عن ملاحظة انخفاض المخزون، وتدوير العناصر (FIFO)، وتقليل الهدر. لماذا أ، ب، وج غير صحيحة: المسؤولية مشتركة بين الجميع، ولا تقتصر على دور واحد.

question.en: How does a refrigerated drier remove moisture from air lines?
question.ar: كيف يزيل مجفف الهواء المبرد الرطوبة من خطوط الهواء؟

choices.en: By absorbing moisture using a desiccant material.
choices.ar: عن طريق امتصاص الرطوبة باستخدام مادة مجففة.

choices.en: By spinning the air to separate water through centrifugal force.
choices.ar: عن طريق تدوير الهواء لفصل الماء بقوة الطرد المركزي.

choices.en: By cooling the air, which forces water vapour to condense into a liquid.
choices.ar: عن طريق تبريد الهواء، مما يجبر بخار الماء على التكثف إلى سائل.

choices.en: By heating the air to evaporate all water vapour.
choices.ar: عن طريق تسخين الهواء لتبخير كل بخار الماء.

en.plain: Why C is correct: Refrigerated air dryers work by cooling the compressed air in a heat exchanger. This cooling forces the water vapour (humidity) in the air to condense into liquid water, which is then separated and drained. Why A is incorrect: This describes a desiccant dryer . Why B is incorrect: This describes a water separator or filter. Why D is incorrect: Heating air would allow it to hold *more* moisture, not remove it.

richText.content:
• Why C is correct: Refrigerated air dryers work by cooling the compressed air in a heat exchanger. This cooling forces the water vapour (humidity) in the air to condense into liquid water, which is then separated and drained.
  • Why A is incorrect: This describes a desiccant dryer.
  • Why B is incorrect: This describes a water separator or filter.
  • Why D is incorrect: Heating air would allow it to hold *more* moisture, not remove it.

question.en: State the purposes of an air transformer regulator.
question.ar: اذكر أغراض منظم محول الهواء.

choices.en: To remove dirt, oil, and water, and to lubricate tools.
choices.ar: لإزالة الأوساخ والزيت والماء، وتشحيم الأدوات.

choices.en: To cool the air, remove moisture, and increase pressure.
choices.ar: لتبريد الهواء وإزالة الرطوبة وزيادة الضغط.

choices.en: To remove dirt, oil, and water, and to reduce/control pressure.
choices.ar: لإزالة الأوساخ والزيت والماء، وتقليل/التحكم في الضغط.

choices.en: To heat the air, remove oil, and increase volume (cfm).
choices.ar: لتسخين الهواء وإزالة الزيت وزيادة الحجم (cfm).

en.plain: Why C is correct: An air transformer regulator is a multi-purpose device that first filters and then regulates. It removes dirt, oil, and water while also reducing line pressure to a constant working pressure. Why A is incorrect: Air transformers for *painting* must *never* lubricate the air. Why B and D are incorrect: Transformers do not cool/heat the air or increase pressure/volume.

richText.content:
• Why C is correct: An air transformer regulator is a multi-purpose device that first filters and then regulates. It removes dirt, oil, and water while also reducing line pressure to a constant working pressure.
  • Why A is incorrect: Air transformers for *painting* must *never* lubricate the air.
  • Why B and D are incorrect: Transformers do not cool/heat the air or increase pressure/volume.

question.en: What is the most effective way to dispose of solvent-soaked shop rags?
question.ar: ما هي الطريقة الأكثر فعالية للتخلص من قطع القماش المبللة بالمذيبات في الورشة؟

choices.en: Air-dry them on a hook before placing in a regular garbage bin.
choices.ar: تجفيفها في الهواء على خطاف قبل وضعها في سلة مهملات عادية.

choices.en: Place them in a bucket of water to prevent ignition.
choices.ar: وضعها في دلو من الماء لمنع الاشتعال.

choices.en: Place them in an approved, covered, metal waste container.
choices.ar: وضعها في حاوية نفايات معدنية معتمدة ومغطاة.

choices.en: Place them in a sealed plastic bag and put in the regular garbage.
choices.ar: وضعها في كيس بلاستيكي محكم الإغلاق ووضعها في المهملات العادية.

en.plain: Why C is correct: Rags soaked with solvents or oils can spontaneously combust (catch fire on their own). The only safe method is to store them in an approved, self-closing metal waste container designed to limit oxygen and contain a potential fire. Why A is incorrect: Air-drying them creates a fire hazard and releases harmful VOCs. Why B and D are incorrect: A bucket of water or a plastic bag are not approved or safe disposal methods for this type of hazardous waste.

• Why C is correct: Rags soaked with solvents or oils can spontaneously combust (catch fire on their own). The only safe method is to store them in an approved, self-closing metal waste container designed to limit oxygen and contain a potential fire.
  • Why A is incorrect: Air-drying them creates a fire hazard and releases harmful VOCs.
  • Why B and D are incorrect: A bucket of water or a plastic bag are not approved or safe disposal methods for this type of hazardous waste.

question.en: Which product has the shortest shelf life?
question.ar: أي منتج له أقصر مدة صلاحية؟

choices.en: Clearcoat
Solvent
Primer
Hardener

en.plain: Why D is correct: Hardeners (isocyanates) have a very short shelf life, often around 10 months *if unopened*. Once opened, they are highly sensitive to moisture (humidity in the air) and can spoil very quickly. Why A, B, and C are incorrect: Clearcoats, solvents, and primers typically have a much longer and more stable shelf life.

question.en: What must be done to a solvent container when transferring to another container to prevent a fire?
question.ar: ما الذي يجب عمله لحاوية المذيب عند النقل إلى حاوية أخرى لمنع نشوب حريق؟

choices.en: It must be cooled.
It must be grounded.
It must be full.
It must be vented.

en.plain: Why B is correct: Always ground the containers when transferring flammable liquids . This (along with bonding) prevents static electricity from building up and causing a spark, which could ignite the flammable vapours. Why A, C, and D are incorrect: These are not the primary safety procedures for preventing a static spark.

richText.content:
• Why B is correct: Always ground the containers when transferring flammable liquids. This (along with bonding) prevents static electricity from building up and causing a spark, which could ignite the flammable vapours.

question.en: Which of the three basic compressor types works on the principle of positive displacement?
question.ar: أي من أنواع الضواغط الأساسية الثلاثة يعمل بمبدأ الإزاحة الإيجابية؟

choices.en: Piston
Rotary Screw
Diaphragm
All of the above

en.plain: Why D is correct: All three compressor types (Piston, Rotary Screw, Diaphragm) work by trapping a volume of air in a chamber and then reducing that chamber's volume to increase pressure, which is the definition of positive displacement . Why A, B, and C are incorrect: Each is an example of positive displacement, so "All of the above" is the most complete answer.

question.en: What is the main advantage of a full-loop air-supply system?
question.ar: ما هي الميزة الرئيسية لنظام إمداد الهواء بالحلقة الكاملة؟

choices.en: It is cheaper to install than a dead-end system.
choices.ar: إنه أرخص في التركيب من نظام النهاية المسدودة.

choices.en: It allows for a consistent air pressure at every air line drop.
choices.ar: يسمح بضغط هواء ثابت عند كل نقطة تفريغ لخط الهواء.

choices.en: It automatically drains water from the lines.
It eliminates the need for an air compressor.

en.plain: Why B is correct: In a full-loop system, air can feed to any drop point from two directions. This balances the load and ensures consistent pressure and volume at all points, even when multiple tools are in use. Why A is incorrect: A full-loop system requires more piping and is more expensive. Why C is incorrect: Draining depends on proper installation (sloping, drain valves), not the loop design itself. Why D is incorrect: A compressor is still required.
